༄༅/ /dpal ri bo che'i sgom chen mtsho skyes la gdams pa'i zhus lan mdo 'gag rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ri bo che'i sgom chen mtsho skyes la gdams pa'i zhus lan mdo 'gag rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/rje mkhyen rab dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shing*// brtse ba'i 'od dkar 'bum 'gyed pa// bstan pa kunda'i nags tshal dag /rnam rgyas mdzad pa de la 'dud// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang gnyis su med pa/ zla bral thams cad mkhyen pa 'bri gung rin po che'i drung du/ 'bangs kyi tha chung sgom chen mtsho skyes kyis zhu ba/ nyid kyi spyan sngar zhu bar 'dod pa'i do gal che ba dag mchis na yang*/ dngos su zhu ba'i spobs pas dben par gyur/ de slad yi ger brgyud nas gsol ba rnams la/ brtse ba'i thugs kyis bdag la bka' lan dag cis kyang thugs rjes 'dzin par mdzad du gsol/ rje phyi nang gi khyad par gang gis 'byed// thun mong skyabs su 'gro ba yi// bslab bya phan yon bsrung bya gang*// thun mong ma yin mthar thug gi /skyabs gnas mchog de gang la bzhed// theg pa che chung khyad par gang*// smon pa 'jug pa'i sa mtshams gang*// kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems// khyad par ngo bo ji ltar lags// don dam cho gas skye lags sam// de yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar bzhed// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// gsungs pa ji ltar yin tshul zhu// mdo sngags khyad par gang gis 'byed// bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom don ci// cho ga rgyas pa dgos lags sam// skad cig dran rdzogs bsgom rung ngam// lam gol med kyi bskyed rim ji ltar bsgom// rin chen nyid kyi zhal snga nas// nged rang sgrub brgyud rin chen 'dis// mos gus kyi lam rnams bgrod gsungs pa// de yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags// mos gus kyi mthar thug gang la bzhed// mos gus phyag rgya chen po zhes// gsungs pa gang la dgongs pa lags// dus mtha'i mos gus gang la bzhed// gzhi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po dang*// 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po dang*// grol lugs phyag rgya chen po zhes// gsungs pa'i dgongs don ji lta bu// 'di nyams su len tshul ji ltar lags// nyams dang rtogs pa'i khyad par gang*// tha mal shes pa zhes gsungs pa// 'di mdzug gu gang la 'dzugs pa lags// sems kyi ngo bo mthong zer ba// 'di spros bral gyi rtogs par bzhed lags sam// 'di la kha cig 'di skad zer// sems kyi ngo bo mthong zer ba// deng sang dus ni mi 'thad la// mdo rgyud dag na gsungs pa med// zer ba 'di la mdo rgyud dang*// lung dang rigs pas ji ltar zlog

/bzhed pa zab pa zhig kyang zhu// pha gcig 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis// bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa'i// lta ba'i mthar thug gang la bzhed// sgom pa skyon med ji lta bu// spyod pa blang dor bral tshul gang*// 'khrul med dge ba'i 'bras bu gang*// thun mong ma yin dgongs pa zhu// stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'char ba dang*// rgyu 'bras stong nyid du 'char ba'i dus// sa mtshams gang gi thad nas lags// skad cig rgyu 'bras 'dor len shes// gsungs pa'i tshul 'di ji lta bu// dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa las// rlung mi 'dzin lhug par 'jog pa zab// rtogs ldan la yang thabs lam lhag par dgos// gsungs pa rdo rje'i gsung 'di gnyis// 'phral du 'gal ba ltar snang na// 'di gnyis 'gal med bzhed par zhu// lar rgyud sde bzhi dang sde snod gsum// man ngag gi gnad du dril lags na// thun gcig gi steng du nyams len pa'i// tshul zhig bdag la gnang bar zhu// yod dge bsngo ba'i tshul 'di la// 'di na kha cig 'di skad zer// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// dus gsum dge ba bsngos zin nas// de las gzhan pa'i yod pa yi// dge ba bsngo bar mi 'thad de// dus gsum las gzhan chos med phyir// khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos dag /cis kyang 'thad pa ma yin zer// 'di la sgrub byed lung rigs dang*// man ngag sgo nas ji ltar zlog /zhib pa'i bka' len ci nas gnongs// rje rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la// lus ngag dang zang zing 'byor pa yis// zhabs tog chen po ma mchis kyang*// bdag sgrub pa cha shas tsam zhig gis// mchod pa 'bul bar 'dod pa la// bdag tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin nas// nyams dang rtogs pa gong 'phel te// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs 'gyur ba'i// shis brjod cig kyang gnang bar zhu// kye ma bdag 'dra byis pa blo zhan po// thos bsam gyis dben blang dor mig dang bral// dben bsten mnyam par bzhag na the tshom mang*// de phyir the tshom som nyi bsal slad du// brtse ba'i ma la bu phrug gis 'bod ltar// rin chen rje la gus pas gsol btab pas// 'di ltar zhus la 'bras bu mchis pa zhig

/cis kyang thugs rjes 'dzin par mdzad du gsol// mdo 'gag rin chen phreng ba zhes// dris las byung ba'i dge ba des// bka' lan bdag la bstsal gyur cig/ ༈ //oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rdo rje 'chang chen nas bzung bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bka' bab chu bo 'dus pa'i gter// byin rlabs bdud rtsi stsol mdzad mgon po dri med zla 'od gzhon nu dang*// de'i sras 'khor ba 'jig gi rnam 'phrul phag gru pa// yongs kyi nying sprul klu sgrub gnyis pa chos kyi rje// sa gsum rnam dkar ba dan ches cher g.yo ba can// mkhyen dang brtse bas 'gro kun skyob pa'i gnyen gcig po// thub dbang nyi ma 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma dam pa rgyal gyur cig /ces mchod par brjod nas gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol 'dzin pa'i tha chung du gyur pa/ 'bri gung spyan snga ā nanda ratna shrī bha dra la/ dpal ri bo che'i chos grwa chen po nas/ bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i sgom chen mtsho skyes kyis/ yang dag pa kho na la rab tu dad pas dri ba'i gnad du ma bskur ba'i lan du cung zad brjod par bya ste/ thog mar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di la phyi nang gi khyad par gang gis 'byed bya ba la/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus pa de nyid nas gsungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gi khyad par 'byed pa'i 'dod lugs shin tu mang yang*/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas la skyabs su gang 'gro ba de nang pa/ mi 'gro ba phyi par byed/ thun mong skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas/ lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba spangs/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs pa dang mi 'grogs/ sangs rgyas kyi rten sātstsha'i dum bu tsam dang*/ chos kyi rten yi ger grub pa tsam dang*/ dge 'dun gyi rten ser mo'i dum bu tsam dang thams cad la gus pa sgrub/

mi gus pa spong ba dang drug yin/ phan yon jo bo rjes rnam pa brgyad du gsungs te/ nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pa dang*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pas gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad srab cing zad par 'gyur ba dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po rdzogs pa dang*/ shi nas ngan song dang ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba dang*/ lam khyad par can rgyud la skye ba dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i phan yon bcas rnams yin/ bsrung thabs gang zhe na/ rang gi rig thog 'dir dge sdig gnyis blang dor ma nor bar bsrungs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa// brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// sa steng 'di dag ko g.yogs na// de nyid ko bas ga la lang*// lham mthil tsam zhig g.yogs pas na// sa steng 'di dag g.yogs dang mtshungs// zhes gsungs so// thun mong ma yin mthar thug gi skyabs gnas gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas chos sku kho na yin te/ theg chen rgyud bla ma las/ spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir// med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa yi// chos rnams gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no// dam pa'i don du 'gro ba'i phyir// skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag cig yin// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug yin// zhes pas rang sems sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su 'gro ba'o// theg pa che chung khyad par gang zhe na/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par sems bskyed de/ sems can thams cad kyi don du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa theg chen/ rang nyid zhi bde 'dod pa theg chung*/ smon 'jug gi sa mtshams gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas thob na bsam pa'i bsam pa de smon pa/ sbyor ba de'i don du dge rtsa sgrub pa 'jug pa'o// kun rdzob dang don dam khyad par ngo bo gang zhe na/

kun rdzob smon 'jug gnyis/ don dam mnyam gzhag ngo bo zung 'jug gi go 'phang la byed/ don dam kyang cho gas e skye zhe na/ cho gas skye ba'i grogs byed de/ ngo 'phrod pa rang cho ga rkyang pas mi 'grub par 'dod/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gang zhe na/ stong nyid de don dam sems bskyed/ snying rje de kun rdzob sems bskyed yin te/ byang sa las sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang*// dad pa dang ni mos pa dang*// dge ba yang dag bsgrubs pa ni// rigs kyi rtags su shes par bya// zhes pas/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis su byed do// mdo sngags khyad par gang zhe na/ mdo sngags kyi khyad par dbang gis 'byed de/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ gang zhig dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar// rnal 'byor pa ni rnal 'byor 'dod// mkha' la khu tshur rdeg pa dang*// smig rgyu chu ni 'thung dang mtshungs// zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor gcig tu ma zhugs na/ mtshan nyid pa mi thob pa'o// bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom don ci zhe na/ grol lam thob phyir bskyed rim bsgom// zhes so// cho ga rgyas pa dgos sam zhe na// dbang po yang rab don go ba la cho ga rgyas par dgos so// skad cig dran rdzogs su rung ngam zhe na/ shin tu rung ste dbang po tha ma las dang po la'o// lam gol med kyi bskyed rim ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ gol sa ye med na/ bskyed rdzogs kyi tha snyad las 'das shing mi slob zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob pa'o// mos gus kyi lam rnams bgrod ces bdag gis zer ba ci lta bu zhe na/ sangs rgya ba'i lam de chos sku thob nas 'byung bar byed pa bla ma'i mos gus gcig pu las med de/ kyai rdo rje las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes so// mos gus kyi mthar thug gang zhe na/ mos gus kyi mthar thug mnyam nyid rtogs pa'o// mos gus gang la dgongs zhe na/

gnas skabs kyi mos gus dang mthar thug gi mos gus gnyis yin/ gnas skabs kyi mos gus zhes pa/ zhen pa nas bzung ste yon tan can du mthong ba'i bar dang*/ mthar thug gi mos gus dus mtha'i mos gus dang gcig ste/ bla ma chos skur shes pa'o// gzhi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po/ 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po/ grol lugs phyag rgya chen po rnams ji lta bu zhe na/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po de sangs rgyas kyis sgam ste bzos/ sems can gyis sgrim ste bshig pa med/ gzhi mal mal/ dog cam cam/ babs dang gshis lugs bya ba ste/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po yin/ 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po bya ba/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi rtog pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ legs pa la chags/ nyes pa la sdang*/ bar pa la 'dzin pa zhugs/ chags sdang gnyis las 'khor ba bskyed pa de 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po/ grol lugs phyag rgya chen po/ gzhi'i gnas lugs de ngo shes nas/ lam ma bcos par nyams su blangs te/ gzung 'dzin chags sdang gnyis las grol ba de grol lugs phyag rgya chen po yin par 'dod/ nyams su ji ltar len zhe na/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ sems ma bcos pa ni chos kyi sku zhes pas grol lugs phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su bstan pa ltar ro// nyams dang rtogs pa'i khyad par gang zhe na/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa rnams so// rtogs pa ni nyams dag nas/ sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba zhes pa lhag mthong ste/ yod par yang ma mthong*/ med par yang ma mthong ste/ mdo sdud pa las/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par gyis// de bzhin chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// zhes pa ltar/ ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam// mthong ba brtan phyir sgom pa'i lam// zhes pas/ theg pa chen po'i mthong lam gyi ting nge 'dzin nas bzung ste/

mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'char ba'i bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan thob pa'i bar du rtogs par ngos 'dzin dgos so// tha mal gyi shes pa mdzub mo gang la 'dzugs zhe na/ rtog pa snga ma 'das/ phyi ma ma shar ba'i da ltar gyi shes pa rjen pa 'di la zer ba yin/ sa ra ha'i do ha las/ tha mal shes pa ma bzung bde chen rgyal po nyid// mtshan nyid cir yang ma mthong phyogs cha kun dang bral// 'khrul pas brtag pa'i bsam brjod 'di ni glo bur ste// blo las 'das phyir blo yis bsgom du ga la yod// ces so// sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba spros bral la zer ram zhe na/ 'di la ngo mthong tsam gong du bkod pa ltar lhag mthong la byed de/ spros bral la dngos gzhir bshad pa 'gal ba med do// kha cig gi sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba deng sang dus na med/ mdo rgyud nas ma gsungs zer ba la lan ji ltar byed zhe na/ de'i rgol lan 'di ltar du bzlog ste/ dper na rje btsun chen po dang*/ mnyam med dwags po rin po che/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po la sogs brgyud pa gong ma rim par byon pa rnams kyi phyi thos pa rkyang pa la ma ltos par/ sgom pa la brten nas sems kyi ngo bo rtogs nas sangs rgyas/ sangs rgyas nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi rtsa kha bye/ rtsa mdud rnams grol/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab/ mdo rgyud kyi don la chags thogs med pa'i shes rab thob/ dbu la gtsug gtor zhabs la 'khor lo byung ba rnams gang gis 'grub/ rgya bod kyi grub thob lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod 'grub pa rnams dang*/ rwa sgreng du rnal 'byor pa phyag khri mchog sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod song ba rnams cis 'grub/ mdo rgyud nas ma bshad na theg pa chen po'i mthong lam gyi ting nge 'dzin gang zag gi rgyud la 'char ba/ bstan pa ma zhig gi bar du yod ces gsungs pa/

bstan pa ni deng sang gnas pa'i sgang du yod pas so// sngags kyi nang nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi slob ma dgra bcom pa siṅgha gling pa dpon slob/ siṅgha gling gi rgyal po rim gyis byung ba rnams kyis rtsis gung bsgrigs nas bshad pa/ khro phu lo tsā bas bsgyur ba las/ sngar 'das thub pa'i bstan pa ni// stong phrag gcig dang bdun brgya'i lo// de bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang*// zla dgu zhag ni bcu dgu 'das// lo ni stong phrag gsum dang ni// phyed dang sum brgya zla ba gnyis// nyi ma bcu gcig da bzod gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo stong brgyad brgya dang bcu gnyis las ma song*/ 'grel chen dri med ltar na/ lo stong drug brgya dang bzhi bcu las ma song*/ de ltar lhag mthong gi dus la yod pas/ 'jig rten gsum mgon kyang mnyes nas/ 'di skad gsungs/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// bdag cag sgrub pa byed pa rnams// 'bras bu rgya chen thob pa la// mkhas pa dga' ba cis mi skye// gsungs pas so// des na mdo rgyud thams cad nas ma gsungs zhes pa/ thos chung mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gyi grub mtha' yin/ deng sang gsang sngags dus min zer ba dang*/ sgom pa'i dus min/ smon lam gyi dus yin zer nas/ lta ba'i gnad rnams bor ba dag ni 'khor ba las thar ba'i dus med pa'o// pha gcig 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi/ lta sgom spyod 'bras ji lta bu zhe na/ lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa la byed/ sgom pa yid byed dang bral ba la byed/ spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba rigs spyod khyad par du 'phags pa tshul khrims la byed/ blang dor bral ba'i tshul gang zhe na/ sdig pa blang du med/ dge ba dor du med pa/ lam mtho dman gang gi dus dgos zhes pa/ lam mtho dman gnyis char du dgos so// 'bras bu bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'o// stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'char ba dang*/

rgyu 'bras stong nyid du 'jug pa'i sa mtshams gang zhe na/ snga ma lta ba rtogs nas mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya gzigs nas blang dor byed pa de sa mtshams/ phyi ma rgyu 'bras stong nyid du shar nas yang mkhyen pa'i ye shes su song nas/ rgyu 'bras blang dor byed pa de sa mtshams/ skad cig rgyu 'bras blang dor zhes gsungs pa de gang zhe na/ dus ring ba phyi ma sogs la ltos ma dgos par mthong chos bde blag tu 'thob ste/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis skad cig mar gsungs pa dgongs gcig tu bzhugs pa ltar ro// rlung mi 'dzin pa lhug par 'jog pa gnad zab pa dang*/ rtogs ldan la thabs lam dgos pa 'gal ba ltar snang yang 'gal med bzhed pa zhu bya ba la/ mi 'gal te/ rtogs ldan la thabs lam dgos pa rtsa rlung la brten dgos te rlung dgos/ dgos pa'i rlung 'dzin pa zab par 'dod de/ rje nyid mi 'dzin pa zab par bzhed/ ma bzung ba zab pa rlung sems gnyis med la dgongs pa'o// mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad thun gcig gi nang du dril nas dgos pa la/ gdan gcig gi steng du thun gcig gis nyams su len pa tshang la rdzogs pa zab mo lnga ldan yin te/ rig pa skad cig ma la lnga ldan tshang ste/ tshang tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa ni byams pa chen po/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje ni snying rje chen po'o// don dam byang chub kyi sems ni rig pa skad cig ma yin/ yi dam yang yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin las// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// zhes pas so// bla ma sku bzhi kho rang ste/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ sems nyid ngo bos stong pa chos kyi sku// gsal la ma 'gags pa de longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs rtog med shar ba sprul pa'i sku// de phyir chos rnams med ces ngo bo nyid// ces so// phyag rgya chen po ni kho rang*/ bsngo ba ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo ba ni bsngo ba chen po zhes mdo nas gsungs pas de ltar du nyams su longs/

bsngo ba yod dge mi 'thad ce na/ dus gsum las lhag yod dge gang*// khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos gang*// zhes pa'i rgol lan ji ltar bzlog ces pa de la rgol ba 'di ltar bzlog yod dge bsngo bar/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba'i le'u las gsungs te/ gshis kyi dge ba dang*/ gshis kyi mi dge ba gnyis yod/ gshis kyi dge ba 'di 'dus ma byas kyang bsngo bar bshad de/ rgyan stug po'i mdo las/ chu dang me shel nor bu dag /yongs su dag pa'i mtshan nyid can// nyi zla'i 'od kyi phog pa na// de dag nyid kyi yon tan 'byin// bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// zag med yon tan ldan pa de// bsngos par gyur na yon tan 'byin// zhes gshis kyi dge ba de sngo ba ste/ de dus gsum gyi dge ba la 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis yod pas/ dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i zhes pa/ dus gsum du bsags pa 'dus byas la dmigs/ yod pa'i dge ba 'dus ma byas par dmigs pas so// 'dus ma byas la bsngos pas 'gyur rgyu dang*/ ma bsngos pas mi 'gyur rgyu med ce na/ chos dbyings de bzhin nyid kyi bden pa dang zhes brjod kyang bden pa med par 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dus ma byas pa'i phyir zhes rigs pa 'phen par bgyi'o// 'di rnams kyi sgrub byed lung rigs man ngag mang du yod kyang*/ yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas dngos len tsam la brten te bskur ba'o// gang zhig thos pas dregs shing bsgrub pa lhur mi len pa'i byis pa'i ngang tshul can// 'ga' zhig sgom pa yod ces dregs nas thos bsam spong ba blun po'i ngang tshul can// phyogs re 'dzin pa'i gang zag de dag thams cad la// thabs la mkhas par byas nas zung 'jug ston par rigs// zhes pa'i bar gyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// 'di rnams kyi sgro 'dogs 'dir gnas pa'i skabs su ci nas kyang gcod par rigs kyang ma byung bas/

ri mor sbyar ba rnams kyi go don ma sol na/ rje 'jig rten mgon po'i chos mdzod rnams su blta ba dang*/ slad rol du dngos su sgro 'dogs gcod par yang bya'o// khyed rang gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba dang*/ gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ ji ltar bsngos bzhin smon lam btab pa thams cad chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /de de kho na nyid du 'grub par gyur cig /shin tu 'grub par gyur cig /mdo 'gag rin chen phreng ba'i dris lan byas pa'i dge ba des// rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// mchog dman bar ma'i gdul bya sems can rnams// gnyis med rdo rje ye shes thob par shog /dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig// maṅgalaṃ//
